`final class GlslExport`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.shader` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [GlslExport.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/shader/GlslExport.java)

Writes every built-in shader of JOID translated to every GLSL dialect, to check a translation with the compilers of each dialect.

## Learn more

- [Check your translation](/build/shader-translation/#check-your-translation)

<a id="GlslExport-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `void` | [main](#GlslExport-method-main)(String[] args) <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Exports into the folder given as the only argument; with another number of arguments, prints its usage and exits with `2`. |
| `void` | [export](#GlslExport-method-export)(File directory) <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Writes, in one subfolder per dialect, the `.vert` and `.frag` of every built-in shader and of its line variant. |

## Method details

<a id="GlslExport-method-main"></a>

### main

`void main(String[] args)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Exports into the folder given as the only argument; with another number of arguments, prints its usage and exits with `2`.

<a id="GlslExport-method-export"></a>

### export

`void export(File directory)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IOException`: The folder … cannot be created, check that its parent folder can be written

Writes, in one subfolder per dialect, the `.vert` and `.frag` of every built-in shader and of its line variant.
Throws an `IOException` when a subfolder cannot be created.
